examples.native: Guten Morgen, wie geht es dir heute?
examples.pronunciation: ɡuːtn̩ mɔʁɡn̩, viː ɡeːt ɛs diːɐ̯ hɔɪ̯tə
examples.translation: Good morning, how are you today?

examples.native: Vielen Dank für deine großartige Unterstützung.
examples.pronunciation: fiːlən daŋk fyːɐ̯ daɪ̯nə ɡʁoːsʔaːɐ̯tɪɡə ʊntɐˈʃtʏtsʊŋ
examples.translation: Thank you very much for your great support.
Nothing to thank for, you are very welcome!

examples.native: Einen schönen Tag noch und auf Wiedersehen!
examples.pronunciation: aɪ̯nən ʃøːnən taːk nɔx ʊnt aʊ̯f viːdɐzeːən
examples.translation: Have a nice day and goodbye!

examples.native: Sehr gerne, ich helfe dir dabei sofort.
examples.pronunciation: zeːɐ̯ ɡɛʁnə, ɪç hɛlfə diːɐ̯ daːbaɪ̯ zoˈfɔʁt
examples.translation: Very gladly, I will help you with that right away.

examples.native: Entschuldigung, wo ist die Toilette bitte?
examples.pronunciation: ɛntˈʃʊldɪɡʊŋ, voː ɪst diː tolɛtə bɪtə
examples.translation: Excuse me, where is the restroom please?

examples.native: Entschuldigen Sie, wie viel kostet dieses Buch?
examples.pronunciation: ɛntˈʃʊldɪɡn̩ ziː, viː fiːl kɔstət diːzəs buːx
examples.translation: Excuse me, how much does this book cost?

examples.native: Freut mich, Sie kennenzulernen. Wie heißen Sie?
examples.pronunciation: fʁɔɪ̯t mɪç ziː kɛnəntsuːlɛʁnən. viː haɪ̯sn̩ ziː
examples.translation: Pleased to meet you. What is your name?

examples.native: Verzeihung, wissen Sie, wie spät es ist?
examples.pronunciation: fɛɐ̯ˈtsaɪ̯ʊŋ, vɪsn̩ ziː viː ʃpɛːt ɛs ɪst
examples.translation: Pardon, do you know what time it is?

examples.native: Natürlich gerne, nimm dir ruhig Zeit.
examples.pronunciation: natyːɐ̯lɪç ɡɛʁnə, nɪm diːɐ̯ ʁuːɪç tsaɪ̯t
examples.translation: Naturally with pleasure, take your time.

examples.native: Mach dir keine Sorgen, das ist kein Problem.
examples.pronunciation: max diːɐ̯ kaɪ̯nə zɔʁɡn̩, das ɪst kaɪ̯n pʁobleːm
examples.translation: Do not worry, that is no problem.

examples.native: Genau so ist es, ich stimme vollkommen zu.
examples.pronunciation: ɡəˈnaʊ̯ zoː ɪst ɛs, ɪç ʃtɪmə fɔlˈkɔmən tsuː

examples.native: Guten Appetit an alle am Tisch!
examples.pronunciation: ɡuːtn̩ apətiːt an alə am tɪʃ
examples.translation: Enjoy your meal everyone at the table!
